2122553383215362253.en_summary: Quote from Dario Amodei on open source models: when you control a model and deploy it, you can monitor usage, revoke access, change what it does; uncontrolled release means no ability to do that. Questions who "you" is, noting Amodei doesn't believe intelligence should be in the hands of the masses.
2122553383215362253.zh_summary: 引用Dario Amodei關於開源模型的話：當你控制一個模型並部署它時，你可以監控使用情況、撤銷訪問、改變它願意做的事；不受控制的發佈意味著無法做到這些。質疑「你」是誰，指出Amodei不相信智能應該掌握在大眾手中。

2122550660914917479.en_summary: Important update on NVIDIA and the Megaspeed investigation. DOJ and Department of Commerce confirmed: Commerce began investigating Megaspeed in 2024, requested NVIDIA’s sales records in May 2025, NVIDIA placed Megaspeed on its “no sell” list in June 2025, DOJ took over criminal investigation. Statement does NOT accuse Jensen Huang or NVIDIA of any criminal wrongdoing.
2122550660914917479.zh_summary: 關於NVIDIA和Megaspeed調查的重要更新。司法部和商務部確認：商務部於2024年開始調查Megaspeed，2025年5月要求NVIDIA的銷售記錄，NVIDIA於2025年6月將Megaspeed列入「禁售」名單，司法部隨後接管刑事調查。聲明並未指控黃仁勳或NVIDIA有任何刑事不法行為。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 2025年6月將Megaspeed列入禁售名單，調查未指控刑事不法

2122549450920821072.en_summary: Skeptical comment on a senior Nvidia employee letter arguing that failure to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO could lead to loss of irreplaceable talent, saying it would require someone who joined before the AI bubble to take seriously.
2122549450920821072.zh_summary: 對一名資深Nvidia員工信件的懷疑評論，該信件主張若不恢復黃仁勳為CEO可能導致無可替代人才流失，表示需要AI泡沫前加入的人才會認真對待。

2122549276454814093.en_summary: Bill Gurley @bgurley on Anthropic’s remarkable business and controversial vision for AI, what Jensen’s exit means for competition, and "handoverism" the idea that humans might one day cede control to AI. Covers Anthropic, Nvidia and the fight over AI competition, open source preventing monopolies, AI spending, and whether Nvidia should bring Jensen back.
2122549276454814093.zh_summary: Bill Gurley @bgurley談論Anthropic出色的業務和對AI的爭議性願景、黃仁勳退出對競爭的意義，以及「handoverism」人類可能有一天將控制權交給AI的想法。涵蓋Anthropic、Nvidia與AI競爭之爭、開源防止壟斷、AI支出，以及Nvidia是否應讓黃仁勳回來。
